facts.fact: Countdown to 2030 reports national health facility data from DHIS2 for 2019-2024, with 96% of expected monthly facility reports received nationally in 2024 and 93% of districts at 90% completeness or better.
Countdown to 2030 gives national DHIS2 completeness of monthly facility reporting as 86% in 2019 rising to 96% of expected monthly reports in 2024.
